sanskrit: nava ca yā navatiś cārūḍhā vakṣaṇā anu | itas tāḥ sarvā naśyantu nuttāḥ putthajño mayā ||
english: Those ninety-nine that have mounted along the flanks — let them all perish from here, driven off by me, the knower of putthajñī.

sanskrit: sapta ca yāḥ saptatiś cārūḍhā vakṣaṇā anu | itas tāḥ sarvā naśyantu nuttāḥ putthajño mayā ||
english: Those seventy-seven that have mounted along the flanks — let them all perish from here, driven off by me, the knower of putthajñī.

sanskrit: pañca ca yāḥ pañcāśac cārūḍhā vakṣaṇā anu | itas tāḥ sarvā naśyantu nuttāḥ putthajño mayā ||
english: Those fifty-five that have mounted along the flanks — let them all perish from here, driven off by me, the knower of putthajñī.

sanskrit: ūrubhyāṃ te 'ṣṭhīvadbhyāṃ pārṣṇibhyāṃ bhaṃsasaḥ | striyā jāra iva putthajñīṃ pra mṛṇīmasi ||
english: From your thighs, from your knee-joints, from your heels and buttocks — we crush the putthajñī as a woman's paramour.

sanskrit: anusṛptāṃ gahaneṣu dhrūkṣṇāṃ pāpīṃ śimidvatīm | tām etāṃ dasyūnāṃ dāsīṃ pra dahātaś cukākaṇi ||
english: Her who has crept into the thickets, the harmful, wicked one, the trembling one — that demoness who is the slave of the dasyus: burn her away, O Cukākaṇi.

sanskrit: yā strīṇāṃ putrasadanaṃ kevaṭān upasarpati | tām etāṃ dasyūnāṃ dāsīṃ pra dahātaś cukākaṇi ||
english: She who creeps into the birth-chamber of women, into the hollows — that demoness who is the slave of the dasyus: burn her away, O Cukākaṇi.

sanskrit: pra patātaḥ sukaṭanāḍi suṣeḥ kuṣītako yathā | srakve te tipraṃ dhakṣyāmi sā naśiṣyasi putthagi ||
english: Fall away now, O needle-pipe of suṣa, like the kuṣīṭaka worm — I shall burn sharply at your palate; you shall perish, O putthagī.

sanskrit: yadāsyāḥ srakve dahed yadā mūrdhānam agninā | athaiṣā dasyūnāṃ dāsī putthagi ni layiṣyate ||
english: When her palate shall burn and when her head shall burn with fire — then shall this slave of the dasyus, this putthagī, dissolve utterly.

sanskrit: saṃvatsaram acaro asurebhyaḥ prataṅkinī | yatra kṣetrasya durgandhi tat ta etan nyañcanam ||
english: For a full year you roamed, O prataṅkinī, from among the asuras — where the field emits its foul smell, there is this, your lurking-place.

sanskrit: naitat tava mātaraṃ sthā na ta etan nyañcanam | asmākam etad vīrebhyo devaiḥ prajananaṃ kṛtam ||
english: This is not your mother's abode; this is not your lurking-place — this has been made by the gods as a place of procreation for our heroes.

sanskrit: girau te 'śma putram udakaṃ himavatsu | tatropapraskadya nṛty ajāmi yūtheṣu putthagi ||
english: Your stone-child is on the mountain, your water among the Himāvats — leaping thither, dance, O putthagī, among the herds of goats.

sanskrit: sa tvaṃ gobhir aśvaiḥ prajayā prataraṃ bhava | yo mā tatra prāhaiṣīr yatra jīvanti bhadrayā ||
english: May you be surpassed by cattle, horses, and offspring — by the one who sent me there where they live in prosperity.

sanskrit: mitraḥ pṛthivyod akrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ | tām ā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||
english: Mitra has ascended from the earth; I lead that stronghold forth to you — enter it, advance into it; may it grant you shelter and armor.

sanskrit: vāyur antarikṣeṇod akrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ | tām ā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||
english: Vāyu has ascended through the atmosphere; I lead that stronghold forth to you — enter it, advance into it; may it grant you shelter and armor.

sanskrit: sūryo divod akrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ | tām ā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||
english: Sūrya has ascended from the sky; I lead that stronghold forth to you — enter it, advance into it; may it grant you shelter and armor.

sanskrit: candramā nakṣatrair ud akrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ | tām ā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||
english: Candramā has ascended with the nakṣatras; I lead that stronghold forth to you — enter it, advance into it; may it grant you shelter and armor.

sanskrit: soma oṣadhībhir ud akrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ | tām ā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||
english: Soma has ascended with the herbs; I lead that stronghold forth to you — enter it, advance into it; may it grant you shelter and armor.

sanskrit: yajño dakṣiṇābhir ud akrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ | tām ā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||
english: The sacrifice has ascended with the dakṣiṇās; I lead that stronghold forth to you — enter it, advance into it; may it grant you shelter and armor.

sanskrit: samudro nadībhir ud akrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ | tām ā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||
english: The ocean has ascended with the rivers; I lead that stronghold forth to you — enter it, advance into it; may it grant you shelter and armor.

sanskrit: brahma brahmacāribhir ud akrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ | tām ā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||
english: Brahman has ascended with the brahmacārins; I lead that stronghold forth to you — enter it, advance into it; may it grant you shelter and armor.

sanskrit: indro vīryeṇod akrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ | tām ā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||
english: Indra has ascended with heroic might; I lead that stronghold forth to you — enter it, advance into it; may it grant you shelter and armor.

sanskrit: devā amṛtenod akrāman tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ | tām ā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||
english: The gods have ascended with amṛta; I lead that stronghold forth to you — enter it, advance into it; may it grant you shelter and armor.

sanskrit: prajāpatiḥ prajābhir ud akrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ | tām ā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||
english: Prajāpati has ascended with his progeny; I lead that stronghold forth to you — enter it, advance into it; may it grant you shelter and armor.

sanskrit: saṃyujyantaḥ prakṛṣanto yad vo devā upocire | tām ebhyaḥ satyām āśiṣam indra khalvāṃ sam ardhaya ||
english: Joining and drawing out, when the gods spoke the blessing over you — that true blessing: bring it to fulfillment for these, O Indra, here on the threshing-floor.

sanskrit: anaḍvāhaḥ satyāvānaḥ sīraṃ kṛṇotu me vacaḥ | yatrāhaitad dhitāya te tat parjanyo 'bhi vo vṛṣat ||
english: May the oxen of true strength make the plough respond to my word — where I have set this down for your benefit, may Parjanya rain down upon you.

sanskrit: divyā āpo vaḥ śakvarīr anu vi yantu gahvare | ūrjasvatīr ghṛtavatīḥ payasvatīr dṛśe bhavata mā guhā ||
english: May the celestial, mighty waters flow out for you along the hollow — rich in vigor, rich in ghee, rich in milk: be visible, do not be hidden.

sanskrit: ud ehi vājinīvatī pūrṇapātrā tviṣīmatī | duhānā pūṣarakṣitā kāmam eṣāṃ sam ā pṛṇa ||
english: Rise up, O bearer of strength, with vessel full and blazing splendor — flowing freely, guarded by Pūṣan: fill the desire of these to the brim.

sanskrit: iyaṃ sītā phalavatī śatavalśā vi rohatu | iyaṃ sahasrabhogā asyā indra upāvatu ||
english: May this furrow, fruit-bearing and hundred-branched, spread forth and grow — this one of thousandfold enjoyment: may Indra give it his aid.

sanskrit: aśvinā phālaṃ kalpayatām upāvatu bṛhaspatiḥ | yathāsad bahudhānyam ayakṣmaṃ bahupūruṣam ||
english: May the Aśvins make the plough-share ready; may Bṛhaspati lend aid — so that it may be rich in grain, free from disease, rich in men.

sanskrit: yad vo devā upocira iha bhūyaḥ syād iti | iha tām utpṛṇāṃ vayaṃ devīm upa hvayāmahe ||
english: What the gods spoke over you — "may it be more abundant here" — that divine fullness we here invoke.

sanskrit: idaṃ ma ut pṛṇād iti sphātiṃ ma ut pṛṇād iti | rāśiṃ me vardhayād iti ||
english: "May this fill me up" — so it is said; "may prosperity fill me up" — so it is said; "may it increase my heap" — so it is said.

sanskrit: sphātikāro bahukāraḥ sphirasphoṣṭhāyam akṣitaḥ | khalo jyeṣṭho vibhuḥ prabhuḥ ||
english: Maker of prosperity, maker of abundance — this one, the fat-lipped, inexhaustible: the threshing-floor, the eldest, the all-pervading, the sovereign.

sanskrit: tasmin dhānyaṃ ny upyate yavo vrīhir atho tilaḥ | tasya gṛhṇīta yat kṛtaṃ parikṣāya catuḥśatam ||
english: In it grain is sown — barley, rice, and sesame too — take from it what has been made: four hundred for distribution.

sanskrit: śarkārivan mayāravac cakrīvat kiṃ ca yad vṛṣe | tad vai sphātir upāyatī sarvam evāti ricyate ||
english: Whatever is heaped like gravel, heaped like sand, piled in the wheel-shape, O bull — all that prosperity, as it comes in, overflows entirely.

sanskrit: mahāñjane parā jahi sahasrāpoṣam ardaya | bahvī na oṣadhe bhava samudrasyeva saṃsravaḥ ||
english: Strike down the great darkness; set in motion a thousandfold nourishment — be abundant for us, O herb, like the confluence of the ocean.
